provenance_note: CPU-side aggregation over stored MMQ_ROUTE serving traces (GGML_CUDA_MMQ_ROUTE_LOG) recorded during the 2026-11-18 tp4 four-card Inkling-2-Small-Q3_K_M windows. No GPU window was run.

verdict.label: inconclusive_from_stores_breadth_measured
verdict.reason: Every stored route record is a per-launch aggregate (cols, used); no expert identities exist in any store, so the top-1 share bar of 1.5x the uniform mean (0.03125) cannot be evaluated from bytes on disk. Measured breadth evidence IS recorded here per layer and phase.
verdict.decider_capture: One window on a rented box with --expert-trace plus a producer variant that keeps a 384-bin per-site hit histogram across evals and dumps JSONL at teardown (the site name already carries the layer); >=1000 decode steps at shallow AND deep context. GLM_ROUTE_STATS multiplicity[64] during an Inkling window is a coarser fallback.

record_format_note: Each stored record also carries tiles8=sum_e ceil(h_e/8), tiles=sum_e ceil(h_e/J) and the launch tile width j; on decode rows j=8 so those collapse. They are additional aggregates of the same hidden per-expert hit vector {h_e} that no store records directly, kept here as provenance only.
phase_caveat: 'decode'/'prefill' are batch-shape labels (cols vs PHASE_BOUNDARY), not serving-phase truths: a small prefill tail chunk can land in the small-batch bucket, and each window's ring kept only its first evals, whose phase mix differs by window. Compare by_batch_size rows before reading any pooled phase number.

depth_gap.text: Records carry (eval, site, cols, used) only; no context-position or prompt-depth metadata survives in any store, and each device context's record ring kept only its FIRST evals (capacity 65536/ctx, see stores[].end_notes ran/kept). Which phase those early evals belong to differs by window, so a shallow vs deep split is NOT derivable from disk today and is not extrapolated.
